context.purpose: Notice the target in a meaningful original Yomu situation before being asked to use it.

instruction.form: 〜と書いてあります / 〜という意味です / 〜と言っていました
instruction.meaning: report what a sign says, explain its meaning, and relay what someone said
instruction.commonContrast: 書いてあります points to written information; 言っていました reports spoken information

workedExamples.ja: あの札には「出口」と書いてあります。
workedExamples.reading: あの札には「出口」と書いてあります。
workedExamples.en: An original Yomu context model; use it to notice the target before creating your own response.

guidedPractice.prompt: First find the target in context. Then make a parallel attempt from a cue; the completed response remains hidden until after the attempt.

progressiveHints.text: Choose one situation where you would naturally use 〜と書いてあります / 〜という意味です / 〜と言っていました; do not write the whole sentence yet.
Build the sentence in parts: choose the content first, then check the form that carries report what a sign says, explain its meaning, and relay what someone said.
Compare your form, meaning, and neutral information-sharing with the worked model. Change the content so the response is your own.

retryFeedback.diagnostic: Check the form and meaning again. A common mix-up is this: 書いてあります points to written information; 言っていました reports spoken information
retryFeedback.retryPrompt: Revise one part at a time, then try again with your own content.
